mapping: A spinning platter carries dropped tokens clockwise until they hit a diverter arm clamped to the outer rail, routing each token to the first node it encounters.
parts: The **base** is a heavy square slab with rounded corners, elevated on four cylindrical feet with inset base screws, providing a solid industrial foundation. The **structure** features a thick, fixed outer ring band acting as a rail, and a towering central spindle that supports a cantilevered drop-chute suspended precisely over the target angle. The **mechanism** centers on a dynamic spinning platter adorned with 72 radial tick marks to represent the hash space, riding smoothly within the outer rail. The **subject** is the routing logic itself: tokens (keys) drop from the static chute onto the spinning platter and ride it until they strike a clamped-on diverter node, sliding along its angled blade radially outward to fall into an external catch bin. Adding or removing a node dynamically drops or lifts its entire clamp assembly from the rail.

mapping: A vertical gravity chute where incoming metal blocks push the stack down to evict the bottom one, and a lateral carriage plucks accessed blocks to lift them back to the top, showing exactly how a Least Recently Used cache reorders and drops items.
parts: A solid cast base with a collection tray for evicted items; a vertical structure of four rails forming a storage chute, backed by a plate; an input hopper rail at the top left; a solenoid manifold on the left cheek housing four lateral plungers; a vertical lift mast on the right holding a sliding carriage bracket; a carriage-mounted plunger; and up to five engraved metal cache blocks sliding between these channels.

mapping: Four spring-loaded thread plungers compete to drop into a single socket on a sliding mutex block; only one can fully enter, while the others strike the surface and must wait.
parts: The base consists of a heavy floor plate on four cylindrical feet, corner screws, two end brackets, and two polished horizontal guide rails. The static structure adds a massive overhead gantry beam supported by two rear pillars, housing four vertical actuator bodies with bezel rings and lower flanges. The dynamic mechanism includes the sliding carriage (built from a solid base, a continuous tall back wall, and two front roof segments that form a central open notch) and four plunging threads, each featuring a polished shaft and a solid tip that either drops into the notch or strikes the carriage roof.

The subject consists of up to eight stacked coin-like tokens, each detailed with concentric engraved rings and facing dots.

mapping: A multi-tine feeler comb descends over a bank of eight bistable rocker flags: inserting a token stamps its hashed flags flat, while probing a token checks whether any flag remains upright to stop the comb at half stroke.
parts: The base consists of a ground plate on four stepped brass feet with four corner set-screws, an inset perimeter oil groove, and a soft base shadow. The structure comprises twin cast pillow blocks, a ground central pivot axle with inter-cell spacer rings, a rear travel-stop beam, a front indicator bezel bar, two polished vertical guide pillars with collar stops, and an arched top bridge bar capped with acorn nuts. The subject consists of eight counterweighted rocker-flag toggles with anvil strike heads and latch lips, along with eight engraved front-rail register numeral glyphs.

mapping: A slotted vertical coin-hopper whose tokens represent permitted requests; when a request arrives, a push-slide dispenses a bottom brass token, while an overhead trickle chute refills the stack until full, spilling any excess over an overflow weir.
parts: Base: four stepped cylindrical feet, main beveled base slab, inset perimeter groove, corner screw rings and dots, raised machine plinth. Structure: four vertical corner guide rods, rear graduated index scale bar with level tick marks, top crown retaining collar, inflow trickle chute with support strut, overflow spillway chute, overflow collection cup, lower slide bed plate, front and rear slide guide rails, slide bearing gland, exit drop collar, inclined exit runway, and machined token catch tray. Mechanism: sliding dispenser shuttle with token pocket, push-button actuator drawbar, knurled plunger cap, and helical return spring split into back and front coils. Subject: precision milled brass token pucks stacked in the hopper column, plus exiting discharged tokens and arriving refill tokens.

mapping: A benchtop brass token-metering column with a spring-loaded bottom escapement slide; incoming requests advance the slide to dispense tokens into an exit tray, while an overhead funnel replenishes the column up to a fixed weir that spills excess into an overflow hopper.
parts: Base: stepped isolation feet, primary beveled cast baseplate, perimeter oil groove, corner mounting bolts. Structure: twin arched cast-iron upright cheeks with rear stiffening ribs, tie rods with knurled end-nuts, slotted brass magazine column with front inspection window, engraved level gauge plate (1 to 5), overhead feed funnel with mounting bracket, and brass overflow spillway leading to a side catchment bin. Mechanism: milled sliding dispenser drawer with token aperture, guide gib rails, hardened push-rod with knurled button cap, split helical return spring (rear and front coils), and front catch basin. Subject: heavy precision brass token pucks with recessed face rims and central pips, resting in the stack, dropping through the escapement slide, or spilling across the overflow weir.
